mechanism_narrative: A sharp increase in the Consumer Price Index (CPI) above 2.5% year-over-year signals inflationary pressure, leading to tighter monetary policy expectations and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 produces positive 20-day returns in > 60% of triggered instances despite the negative signal, or CPI YoY increases > 2.5% without subsequent tightening by the Fed.

mechanism_narrative: A significant decrease in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) by more than 0.5% over the previous month signals a strengthening labor market, boosting consumer confidence and driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 produces negative 5-day returns in > 60% of triggered instances despite the positive signal, or UNRATE decreases > 0.5% MoM without subsequent consumer confidence improvement.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in real estate activity (HOUST) signals a strengthening demand side of the economy, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 produces negative 60-day returns in > 50% of periods following sustained HOUST increases, or HOUST increases without corresponding GDP growth.

mechanism_narrative: A significant decline in industrial production (INDPRO) by more than 1% month-over-month signals a weakening supply side of the economy, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 produces positive 20-day returns in > 60% of triggered instances despite the negative signal, or INDPRO decreases > 1% MoM without subsequent economic slowdown.

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) is above 4% and the Consumer Price Index (CPIAUCSL) is rising, the combination signals a tightening monetary policy and inflationary pressure, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 produces positive 20-day returns in > 60% of triggered instances despite the negative signal, or FEDFUNDS > 4% and CPIAUCSL YoY > 2% without subsequent tightening.

mechanism_narrative: When the unemployment rate (UNRATE) is below 5% and nonfarm payrolls (PAYEMS) increase by more than 200,000, the combination signals a tight labor market and strong economic growth, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
regime_hint: tight labor market with strong growth
failure_condition: S&P 500 produces negative 60-day returns in > 50% of triggered instances despite the positive signal, or UNRATE < 5% and PAYEMS increases > 200,000 without subsequent economic growth.

mechanism_narrative: A significant increase in real final sales (RSAFS) by more than 1% quarter-over-quarter signals strengthening consumer demand, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 produces negative 20-day returns in > 60% of triggered instances despite the positive signal, or RSAFS increases > 1% QoQ without subsequent consumer confidence improvement.

mechanism_narrative: When industrial production (INDPRO) is declining and GDP (GDPC1) growth is below 2% year-over-year, the combination signals a weakening supply side and overall economic slowdown, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
candidate_trigger: INDPRO decreases > 1% MoM and GDPC1 YoY < 2%
failure_condition: S&P 500 produces positive 60-day returns in > 50% of triggered instances despite the negative signal, or INDPRO decreases > 1% MoM and GDPC1 YoY < 2% without subsequent economic contraction.
